what_is_it.explanation: Prefect is a workflow orchestration framework designed to help developers build resilient and dynamic data pipelines in Python. It allows data teams to elevate regular scripts into production workflows with features such as scheduling, caching, retries, and event-based automations. Workflow activity can be tracked and monitored using a self-hosted server or a managed cloud dashboard.
